subject.title: fix(clickclack): add timeouts to REST client requests

question: Should ClickClack standardize on a private 30-second completion deadline for JSON REST operations while leaving multipart uploads unbounded?
rationale: Source and live proof establish that the code works, but repository evidence does not establish the intended ClickClack latency budget or whether indefinite multipart waits are an accepted product contract; that compatibility choice cannot be inferred safely from tests.

options.title: Approve the deadline split
options.body: Accept the private 30-second JSON deadline and the current multipart exception as ClickClack's intended compatibility policy, then refresh and merge the branch.

options.title: Retune operation deadlines
options.body: Choose owner-specific finite budgets for JSON and multipart operations before merge, retaining the same shared timeout mechanism and focused proof.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Leave current behavior unchanged until ClickClack latency and large-upload expectations can be established from production or server contracts.

recommendation.title: Approve the deadline split
recommendation.body: Accept the private 30-second JSON deadline and the current multipart exception as ClickClack's intended compatibility policy, then refresh and merge the branch.

likelyOwner.reason: This is an owner-specific ClickClack latency and compatibility decision rather than a generic plugin SDK implementation question.
